
# set idents
```{r subset}
# set idents
Idents(object = seurat.obj) <- "merged_clusters"
print(table(Idents(object = seurat.obj)))
```
```{r}
# read in anotation
results_table <- "manual_annotation_0.75_withsubcluster6.csv"
results_df <- read.csv(results_table, header = TRUE)
head(results_df)
colnames(results_df)

# Rename the clusters based on the new IDs.
cluster.ids <- as.character(results_df$Celltype)
names(cluster.ids) <- as.character(results_df$ClusterID)

# diagnostic: confirm the two label sets actually match before renaming
print(levels(seurat.obj))
print(names(cluster.ids))

# sanity check: every current cluster level should have a match; should be character(0)
setdiff(levels(seurat.obj), names(cluster.ids))

seurat.obj <- RenameIdents(seurat.obj, cluster.ids)
```
```{r plot_annotated_clusters}
# put in resolution-specific annotation metadata column
seurat.obj[["manual_celltype"]] <- Idents(seurat.obj)
# Generate and plot the UMAP plot
pdf(paste0("labeled-clusters_manual_celltype.pdf"), bg = "white")
print(DimPlot(seurat.obj,
  reduction = "umap", label = FALSE,
  pt.size = 0.5, group.by = "manual_celltype"
) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 7), legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")))
dev.off()
```
```{r dotplot}
gene_list <- c(
  "SOX2", "CDX2", "FGF8", "PAX6", "HES5", "IRX3", "TBXT", "TBX6",
  "HES7", "DLL1", "LFNG", "MESP2", "MEOX1", "PAX3", "TCF15", "ALDH1A2"
)
# order
cluster_order <- c("5", "2", "6_1", "7", "4", "6_2", "1", "3")
seurat.obj$merged_clusters <- factor(seurat.obj$merged_clusters, levels = cluster_order)
# draw dotplot
dp <- DotPlot(seurat.obj,
  features = gene_list, group.by = "merged_clusters",
  cols = c("lightgrey", "darkred")
) +
  coord_flip() + # swap axes: genes on y, cell types on x
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) + # first gene in `genes` at the top
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
# save dotplot
pdf(paste0("dotplot_markers_merged_clusters.pdf"), bg = "white")
print(dp)
dev.off()
```
```{r dotplot2}
# cell type order
celltype_order <- c("Caudal neural progenitor", "Neural tube", "Somite")
# Check the names match the metadata exactly (watch for extra spaces)
setdiff(unique(seurat.obj$manual_celltype), celltype_order) # labels missing from celltype_order
setdiff(celltype_order, unique(seurat.obj$manual_celltype)) # labels in celltype_order not found in metadata
# order
seurat.obj$manual_celltype <- factor(seurat.obj$manual_celltype, levels = celltype_order)
# draw dotplot
dp2 <- DotPlot(seurat.obj,
  features = gene_list, group.by = "manual_celltype",
  cols = c("lightgrey", "darkred")
) +
  coord_flip() + # swap axes: genes on y, cell types on x
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) + # first gene in `genes` at the top
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
# save dotplot
pdf(paste0("dotplot_markers_manual_celltype.pdf"), bg = "white")
print(dp2)
dev.off()
```
```{r heatmap}
hox_gene_list <- c(
  "HOXA1", "HOXA2", "HOXA3", "HOXA4", "HOXA5", "HOXA6", "HOXA7", "HOXA9", "HOXA10",
  "HOXB2", "HOXB3", "HOXB4", "HOXB5", "HOXB6", "HOXB7", "HOXB8", "HOXB9", "HOXC4",
  "HOXC5", "HOXC6", "HOXC8", "HOXC9", "HOXC10", "HOXD1", "HOXD3", "HOXD4", "HOXD8", "HOXD10"
)
# Single cell heatmap of feature expression, cell types as rows and genes as columns
# (DoHeatmap can't be flipped with coord_flip, so build it directly in ggplot)
scaled <- GetAssayData(seurat.obj, layer = "scale.data")
hox_present <- intersect(hox_gene_list, rownames(scaled)) # genes missing from scale.data are dropped
setdiff(hox_gene_list, hox_present) # genes not in scale.data (not plotted)
# keep genes detected (count > 0) in at least 1% of cells; scaling barely-detected genes
# pushes their few expressing cells to scale.max and exaggerates them
min_pct_detected <- 1
counts <- GetAssayData(seurat.obj, layer = "counts")
pct_detected <- Matrix::rowMeans(counts[hox_present, , drop = FALSE] > 0) * 100
print(sort(round(pct_detected, 2)))
hox_present <- hox_present[pct_detected >= min_pct_detected]
m <-as.matrix(scaled[hox_present, , drop = FALSE])
# long format: one row per gene x cell
hm_df <- data.frame(
  gene = factor(rep(rownames(m), times = ncol(m)), levels = hox_present),
  cell = rep(colnames(m), each = nrow(m)),
  expr = as.vector(m)
)
hm_df$celltype <- seurat.obj$manual_celltype[hm_df$cell]
hm_df$expr <- pmin(pmax(hm_df$expr, -2.5), 2.5) # clip like DoHeatmap (disp.min/disp.max)

hm <- ggplot(hm_df, aes(x = gene, y = cell, fill = expr)) +
  geom_raster() +
  # one horizontal band per cell type, band height proportional to number of cells
  facet_grid(rows = vars(celltype), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#FF00FF", "black", "#FFFF00"), name = "Expression") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(), # hide cell barcodes
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 7),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "mm"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)

# save plot
pdf(paste0("heatmap_hox_genes_manual_celltype.pdf"), bg = "white", width = 8, height = 6)
print(hm)
dev.off()
```
